training_reference.scope: V5.2 complete repair curriculum informed by the 2026-09-22 reward audit
training_reference.height_shape: Performance-gated broad-to-narrow kernels plus the existing quadratic far-field cost; height L1 remains zero
training_reference.termination: 100 ms consecutive soft-fall confirmation during training; critical falls and mechanical/contact failures remain immediate; fixed evaluation uses the original single-frame rule
training_reference.causality: Height plateaus, drift and directional failures motivate repairs but do not establish a reward-only root cause
training_reference.robustness: Existing action-rate, acceleration, torque, power and mechanical-margin priors; mixed_robust enables signal delay/noise and actuator/spring perturbations with clean and perturbed acceptance cases
